Nested-logit score test of IIA

Source: R/tests_fit.R
nested_lm_test.Rd

The Lagrange-multiplier (score) test of the multinomial logit against the nested logit with the given nests, evaluated at the multinomial-logit estimates where every inclusive-value parameter equals 1 (McFadden 1987; Hausman and McFadden 1984, section 4). Only the restricted (MNL) fit is needed: the score of the nested-logit log-likelihood with respect to the inclusive-value parameters at \(\lambda = 1\) is combined with the information matrix (by default its outer-product form, McFadden's regression form, positive semidefinite by construction; or the differenced Hessian with information = "hessian"). The test is directional, towards the stated nesting structure, and the sign of each nest's score shows whether the data pull its \(\lambda\) below 1 (correlated errors within the nest) or above.

Usage

nested_lm_test(
  object,
  nests,
  equal_lambda = FALSE,
  information = c("opg", "hessian")
)

Arguments

object

A fitted mnl() model. A fit with diverging coefficients (separation) draws a warning: the statistic is then evaluated where the optimizer stopped, at estimates that do not exist.

nests

A named list assigning every alternative to a nest, as in nlogit().

equal_lambda

If TRUE, one shared inclusive-value parameter (one degree of freedom).

information

"opg" (default; the outer product of the scores, the form of McFadden's regression-based test, positive semidefinite by construction) or "hessian" (the observed information at the restricted estimate, which is not guaranteed positive definite there; a negative statistic is reported with a warning and no p-value).

Value

A data frame of class "iia_test" with the statistic, degrees of freedom, and p-value; the attribute "scores" holds the per-nest scores.

Details

The statistic assumes independent cases: a fit's cluster does not enter it.

References

Hausman, J.A. and McFadden, D. (1984). Specification tests for the multinomial logit model. Econometrica, 52, 1219-1240. doi:10.2307/1910997

McFadden, D. (1987). Regression-based specification tests for the multinomial logit model. Journal of Econometrics, 34, 63-82. doi:10.1016/0304-4076(87)90067-4

See also

nlogit(), lr_test(), iia_tests(), boot_pvalue()

Other IIA tests: boot_pvalue(), fp_tests(), hausman_mcfadden(), iia_tests(), small_hsiao()

Examples

set.seed(2)
d <- rnlogit(2000, beta = cbind(b = c(0.5, -1, 0.8), c = c(-0.3, 0.6, -0.5), d = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.3)),
             nests = list(n1 = c("a", "b"), n2 = c("c", "d")), lambda = c(0.5, 0.5))
m <- mnl(y ~ x1 + x2, data = d)
nested_lm_test(m, nests = list(n1 = c("a", "b"), n2 = c("c", "d")))
#> Lagrange-multiplier test of IIA against a nested logit 
#>                        test statistic df p.value
#>  Nested-logit LM test (opg)    19.441  2   6e-05
